p8Path.description: The `AuthKey_<KEYID>.p8` file (absolute); the key is sealed, never echoed.

AccountAnisetteFetchLibrariesParams.description:

records that the user read the consent screen (SIGN §7.1); anything but `true` is refused.

bytesDownloaded.description: HTTP traffic of the range fetch (about 2–3 MB; 0 when the libraries were already present).

pinned.description: The hashes are in Russet's pin table; false means they were recorded on first use.

AccountAnisetteStatusResult.description: Result of `account.anisette.status`: the local ADI provider (remote servers are configured per account).

librariesPresent.description: Apple's two ADI libraries are downloaded and match their pins (or their trust-on-first-use record).

localSupported.description: Local ADI runs on this host (Linux x86_64; Windows through the engine's WSL backend).

pinned.description: The libraries' hashes are in Russet's shipped pin table (false: recorded on first use).

provisioned.description: This machine holds ADI provisioning state.

AccountAppleIdBeginParams.description:
Params of `account.appleId.begin` (cli/ide only): signs in to Apple with the engine's own GrandSlam client.
`Debug` never prints the Apple ID or the password; neither is logged, audited or echoed.

label.description: The account's label in `account.list` (default: `Apple ID (<masked id>)`).

account.description: With `step: "done"`: the account that was added (or refreshed).

phoneId.description: Required with `via: "sms"`: a `phoneNumbers[].id` of the two-factor step.

AccountAppleIdSubmitCodeParams.description:
Params of `account.appleId.submitCode`: `{sessionId, code} → Account`. The code is checked against the way it
was last requested (the trusted devices unless `requestCode` sent an SMS). `Debug` never prints the code.

AccountImportXtoolParams.description: Params of `account.importXtool` (cli/ide only; the explicit one-time import [D 50]).

dryRun.description: Report what would be imported without sealing or writing anything.

warnings.description:
Advice (always the `chmod 600` / `xtool auth logout` line, which names xtool's directory but none of its
files) and anything skipped.

wipeSecrets.description: Also delete the account's sealed App Store Connect key from the secret store.

remote.description: The base URL of an anisette-v3 server.

AppExitedParams.description: Params of the `app.exited` notification: `{leaseId, pid, code?, signal?, crashId?}; to the app.launch caller`.

path.description: An absolute path to a signed `.app` directory or `.ipa`.

installedPath.description: The app's path on the device (empty when installd did not report it).

AppLaunchParams.description: Params of `app.launch`: `{udid?, bundleId, args?, env?, suspended?, killExisting?, console?} → {pid, executable, leaseId} ⇒ app.output, app.exited`.

console.description: Attach the app's stdio (default true): `app.output` notifications and the `stdout` log source.

killExisting.description: Terminate a running instance first (default true).

suspended.description: Start stopped before `main` (resume with `process.signal` SIGCONT or a debugger).

executable.description: The executable's path on the device (empty after a DVT launch).

leaseId.description: The `app-launch` lease: console and exit notifications go to the caller until it ends.

AppListParams.description: Params of `app.list`: `{udid?, kind?: user|all, bundleIdPrefix?} → {apps: AppInfo[]}`.

AppOutputParams.description: Params of the `app.output` notification: `{leaseId, stream: stdout, data}; to the app.launch caller`.

bundleId.description:
Required; `#[serde(default)]` only so the per-call class can be resolved before validation (the handler
rejects an empty id with `core.invalidArgument`).

AppleIdStep.description: The step a sign-in session is at.

oneOf.description: Signed in: the account is in `account.list` (and in `account` of this result).
Apple asks for a two-factor code: call `account.appleId.submitCode` (after `requestCode` for an SMS).

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC: pending approvals expire 10 min after creation.

tier.description: The MCP tier (2 or 3; 0 for a recorded confirmation).

waitMs.description: Wait up to this long while the approval is pending.

scope.description: Default: `session` for tier 2, `once` for tier 3 (which never allows `session`).

ApprovalRequestedParams.description: Params of the `approval.requested` notification (to `ide` and interactive `cli` connections).

approveWith.description: `russet approve apr_… (or Approve in Russet IDE)`.

tool.description: The MCP tool, when the bridge named it.

ApprovalResolvedParams.description: Params of the `approval.resolved` notification (the same, plus the requester).

oneOf.description: Every call of the method from the requesting MCP session (tier 2) [D 67].

AscGetParams.description: Params of `asc.get`: `{pathAndQuery, accountId?} → {status, body} (allowlisted GET; request-scoped token)`.

outcome.description: `ok`, or the `russetCode` of the error (`perm.denied`, …), or an approval state for `approval` entries.

paramsDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON params without `approval`.

tier.description: The MCP tier of the call.

tool.description: The MCP tool behind the call, when the bridge named it.

oneOf.description: An approval was requested, granted, denied or used.

limit.description: The newest entries to return; default 50.

AuthToken.description: A secret token on the wire: serialized as its string, never printed by `Debug`.

BackgroundJob.description: What a long-running method returns with `background: true` [D 65].

car.description: The asset catalog summary; omitted until the CAR reader exists (W21).

restartable.description: The daemon was idle and accepted `daemon.shutdown {reason: "upgrade"}`.

bundleIds.description: Original → effective bundle IDs (the signing area rewrites entitlements with it).

deploymentTarget.description: `[app] deployment-target`; omitted when the package's `.iOS` platform decides at build time.

product.description: The app product; omitted when only the package description can tell.

bundleIdPolicy.description: The signing area's policy; `[signing] bundle-id-policy` when omitted.

clean.description: Remove the SwiftPM scratch and the profile's outputs first.

configuration.description: `debug`, `release`, `profile` or a named profile; `[build] default-profile` when omitted.

overrides.description: Build-setting overrides (`KEY = VALUE`), on top of `[build] overrides`.

project.description: The absolute project root (or a directory inside it).

target.description: The app product; `[build.swiftpm] product` when omitted.

BundleIdPolicy.description: How effective bundle IDs are derived (ARCHITECTURE §16.5) [D 18].

oneOf.description: `XTL-<PREFIX>.<id>`, the prefix being the first segment of the xtool identity id.

originalBundleId.description: The canonical ID before the bundle-ID policy.

CancelParams.description: Params of the LSP built-in notification `$/cancelRequest` (ARCHITECTURE §7.6).

Capability.description: One capability the developer portal manages (SIGN §6.5).

entitlements.description: The entitlement keys that request it.

freeTeam.description: Whether free (personal) teams can use it.

needsPortalStep.description: Whether part of it needs a manual step in the developer portal (app groups, iCloud containers).

ClientCapabilities.description: What the client can do when the daemon asks (ARCHITECTURE §7.4, §9.3).

ideDebug.description: Serves the IDE reverse requests of ARCHITECTURE §9.4.

interactive.description: True only when a CLI's stdin is a TTY; approval grants require it (ARCHITECTURE §7.4, §11.3).

ClientRef.description: A client as other clients see it: `{kind, name}` (`ui.confirm.requestedBy`, audit entries).

CodeSigningMonitor.description: The device's code-signing monitor (TXM, PPL or none) [D 71].

ConfigChangedParams.description: Params of the `config.changed` notification (to every connection).

ConfigFileInfo.description: A candidate file of the requested scope (`russet config path`).

ConfigFileKind.description: The configuration files with a schema.

key.description: A dotted key in TOML syntax (`daemon.idle-timeout`); omitted = the whole view.

project.description: The project root (absolute); needed for the project and local scopes and for project keys.

files.description: The candidate files of the scope and whether they exist.

sources.description: Where the value came from, highest precedence first.

value.description: The value; omitted when the requested file does not set the key.

oneOf.description: The precedence of ARCHITECTURE §14.1, built-in defaults filled in.

key.description: A dotted key in TOML syntax.

project.description: The project root (absolute); needed for the project and local scopes.

path.description: The file that was (or would have been) written.

ConfigSourceScope.description: Where a value came from (ARCHITECTURE §14.1, highest precedence first).

ConnectionRef.description:
A client connection: `{kind, name, connectionId}` (approvals' `requestedBy` and `grantedBy`, owners of jobs
and leases).

file.description: The source file, when a dSYM resolved it.

image.description: The image (binary) the frame is in, for example `RussetProbe` or `UIKitCore`.

imageOffset.description: The byte offset into the image.

index.description: The frame index within its thread.

inlined.description: Whether this frame was inlined (`symbolic` inline expansion).

line.description: The source line, when a dSYM resolved it.

symbol.description: The resolved symbol, when Russet could name it.

CrashListParams.description: Params of `crash.list`: filter the local store.

since.description: Only crashes at or after this RFC 3339 time.

crashId.description: The stable id in the local store (`<timestamp>-<incident>`).

process.description: The crashing process name (the executable), for example `RussetProbe`.

signal.description: The terminating signal name, for example `SIGSEGV`, when the report has one.

symbolicated.description: Whether a symbolicated rendering is already cached next to the `.ips`.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC of the crash (the `.ips` header's `timestamp`, normalised).

path.description: An `.ips` file to symbolicate without storing it.

crashed.description: Whether this is the crashing thread.

name.description: The thread name or queue label, when known.

dropped.description: Records lost to a slow consumer since the previous batch (ARCHITECTURE §6.4).

DaemonLogRecord.description: One daemon log record (already redacted, ARCHITECTURE §12.2).

DaemonSetLogFilterParams.description: Params of `daemon.setLogFilter`: an `EnvFilter` directive such as `info,russetd=debug`.

force.description: Stop even with active jobs and leases, and skip the 10 s job grace.

reason.description:
Default `request`. With `upgrade` the daemon accepts only when it is idle apart from the requester
(ARCHITECTURE §3.3 item 3).

activeSessions.description: Running or queued jobs plus leases that kept (or would have kept) the daemon alive.

graceMs.description: How long jobs get before their process trees are killed.

devices.description: Devices the device plane knows (0 until it starts, ARCHITECTURE §3.3 item 7).

rssBytes.description: The daemon's resident set size (0 where the platform does not report it).

`details` of the `ipc.daemonUnavailable` (1102) that a stopping daemon answers to `initialize`: it keeps its
endpoint until its jobs have had their grace (core §6.3), so a client waits for it to go and then starts a
new daemon instead of racing the old one for `runtime/russetd.lock`.

graceMs.description: How long the daemon still gives its jobs, at most (`0` when forced).

DapInfo.description: The per-session DAP hub endpoint (ARCHITECTURE §10.2; W11).

DapTransport.description: How the DAP hub is reached.

DdiOrigin.description: Where a mounted DDI came from (Russet's `MountRecord`, ARCHITECTURE §5.3).

DdiSourceParam.description: Where `device.prepare` and `device.ddi.mount` take the DDI from (ARCHITECTURE §8.2, §14.3) [D 62].

A DDI root holding `Restore/` and `version.plist`, or a directory holding `BuildManifest.plist` [D 82].
pymobiledevice3's mirror-derived cache; needs the `allow-mirror` consent (W10).

source.description: The source of Russet's last mount record while the mounted image still matches it, else `unknown` [D 89].

waitForStopMs.description: Wait up to this long for the next stop before returning (0 or omitted returns at once).

scope.description: The variable scope (`locals`, `globals`, …) or a DAP `variablesReference`, for `what: variables`.

stopOnEntry.description: Stay stopped after the attach (no `process continue`).

attachCommands.description: The Python-free attach sequence (RD §9.1); `legacy-async` adds the M1 sequence's `script` lines.

attachScript.description: The `attach.lldb` the daemon wrote: init plus attach commands.

bundleId.description: The bundle ID on the device.

initCommands.description: LLDB settings (RD §8.4), before the attach commands.

confirmBytes.description: Headless and MCP callers must pass the planned total; interactive clients are asked with `ui.confirm`.

keepRawDsc.description: Keep the raw dyld shared cache after extraction (default: delete it).

tier.description: The tier to plan for (defaults to `core`).

ok.description: Whether a fetch is allowed: free space ≥ total + 2 GiB and the quota admits it.

maxBytes.description: Prune least-recently-used sets until the cache is at most this big (defaults to the quota).

build.description: The device's iOS build (`ProductBuildVersion`), when known.

rawDscPresent.description: Whether the raw dyld shared cache is still present (it can be pruned after extraction).

`env` is part of the contract: every launcher applies it (§16.2).

Where a resolved tool came from, in the wire shape of `toolchain.*`'s `ToolInfo.provenance` (W3): an object

udid.description: A UDID or alias; may be omitted when exactly one device is attached (ARCHITECTURE §7.3).
